limitations: No claim that import-count reduction equals an equivalent CPU speedup.
Live JS Arrays, per-node instance addressing and fixed retirement masks have memory/size costs; externref capacity is not RSS.
Leptos selection anomaly retained in primary timings; 72 independent diagnostics reported separately.
Dioxus still materially faster for bulk operations; identity/validation/lifecycle capabilities were preserved.

The experimental production code and added tests were reverted after both cohorts; the active implementation remains the pre-experiment version. The larger instance/mount/retirement batch design was not implemented in this experiment.

environment.scope: System CPU load and active compiler process IDs sampled outside each A/B timing context; unrelated jobs were never changed.

disposition.reason: Two measured cohorts did not establish a worthwhile overall performance improvement; replacement, selection and clear regressed despite fewer bridge/decoder calls. Production implementation restored to the before snapshot.
